query:
MATCH (n)
WHERE toLower(coalesce(n.caller_class, '')) CONTAINS 'get'
   OR toLower(coalesce(n.caller_name, '')) CONTAINS 'get'
   OR toLower(coalesce(n.callee_class, '')) CONTAINS 'get'
   OR toLower(coalesce(n.callee_name, '')) CONTAINS 'get'
RETURN DISTINCT n.caller_class, n.caller_name, n.callee_class, n.callee_name
LIMIT 200
limitations: Logical reference posting cardinalities only, not actual index access counts, measured CPU/latency, or a speedup prediction.
A tuple can have all four individual values present without a complete tuple match. Anchor posting lengths deliberately retain these false candidates and duplicates.
Whole-view integrity, complete selected-posting physical-order validation, budgets/cancellation and provenance still apply; no existing API is assumed to expose this cardinality strategy.
This reference census does not select or implement a new optimization.
